lessons_used: Helpful changes (won): Reordering sign-in after adoption, a new home flow, targeted hints (adoption, path decision, sign-in security), and a path selection layout update significantly improved metrics.
Harmful changes (worse): Streamlined path selection copy (-4.7%) and an account persistence sign-in hint (-5.8%) significantly hurt performance.
No clear effect: Notifications, tutorial/showcase screens, wait time info, incentives, and most copy changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Expected gains were generally overestimated across most tests, including large predicted gains like +15.0% and +14.0%.

Predictions too low: Predictions underestimated gains for multiple winning tests, including the home new flow (+1.0% vs +8.6%), path decision hint (+0.5% vs +3.1%), sign-in security hint (-4.0% vs +3.1%), and card carousel layout (+0.8% vs +5.3%).

candidates.title: Pet Personality Quiz Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pick friend screen layout to card format focused on pet personality traits and behavior styles rather than visual models.
candidates.why: Adoption has a high drop-off rate of 35.8% with an 89s median duration, indicating users struggle to make visual selection choices quickly.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.why: Support receives frequent complaints about pets not showing up on desktop or users not knowing how to control or hide them after completing setup.

new_desktop_dock_guide.headline: Mastering Desktop Pet Controls

candidates.why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing significant drop-off before onboarding finish.

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Desktop Welcomer Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro to split layout featuring an interactive greeting mascot component to verify pet launch before finishing.
candidates.why: Finish stage drops 35.2% of users with an average duration over 5800s, suggesting users get stuck or leave before completion.

home_welcome.text: Your companion is ready to roam your desktop!

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro layout with an interactive mascot component inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish stage suffers heavy drop-off and long durations; full redesign has potential but incurs high implementation cost.

lessons_next: Helpful changes (won): Reordering sign-in after adoption, select new flows (desktop summon), targeted hints (photo upload, path decision, sign-in security), single-click and card carousel layouts, and desktop quick control redesign significantly improved metrics.

Harmful changes (worse): Specific copy changes (streamlined path selection, companion name certification), an account persistence hint, and the spotlight path selector layout significantly hurt performance.
No clear effect: Notifications, tutorial/showcase screens, wait time info/loading indicators, incentives, and several alternative copy, layout, and flow variations showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Large predicted gains were frequently overestimated across tests, including +15.0% (measured +7.0%) and +14.0% (no clear effect).

Predictions too low: Gains were underestimated for multiple winning tests, including home new flow (+1.0% vs +8.6%), sign-in security hint (-4.0% vs +3.1%), card carousel layout (+0.8% vs +5.3%), path helper hint (+0.5% vs +3.1%), and single-click layout (+2.8% vs +5.7%).
